up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records for the organism 'Rattus norvegicus'. For each record, return the following information: 1) The substrate compound name (pref_name), 2) The substrate structure (canonical_smiles or inchi_key), 3) The metabolic conversion description (met_conversion), and 4) Enzyme information (enzyme_name). Join the metabolism table with compound_records and compound_structures to retrieve the substrate details. Filter the results where the organism is 'Rattus norvegicus'. Limit the output to 200 rows.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, m.met_conversion, m.enzyme_name FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.organism = 'Rattus norvegicus' ORDER BY m.met_id LIMIT 200
